notes: 1332 of 1340 unique retail address/extent pairs passed strict comparison in 1344 calibration cases using authentic VC6 SP3 (Linux/wibo). Every relocation was resolved, or the function had no relocation bytes. The remaining 8 (BaseObject::Release and seven UI compiler-shape probes) match only with relocations masked. This excludes the physics runner, whose historical exact label masks relocations, and is not a census of retail functions. RTTI/source-path and .text figures were regenerated from the hash-pinned executable.
